description: ALTER FUNCTION / PROCEDURE rename and comment forms, converted 1:1 from ddl/AlterRoutineTest.java (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION add1(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS $$ x + 1 $$
ALTER FUNCTION add1(INTEGER) RENAME TO plus1
CREATE FUNCTION fc(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS $$ x $$
CREATE PROCEDURE pr() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 'x'; END $$
ALTER PROCEDURE pr() RENAME TO qr
